review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a long slender decurved probing bill with a nostril groove and a rounded tip, on a fleshy gape; lengthens, curves and opens on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartBeakLong_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartBeakLong_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the bill 35% longer above the skin
the decurve about 30 degrees deeper at the tip
the lower mandible dropped 16 degrees at the gape

part_rules.handles_note: All three keys are on BeakLong and BeakLongLower with the same names; the runtime sets them together. H3_Open moves only the lower mandible.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a slender gently decurved bill about 0.23 m out of the skin with a rounded probe tip and a fleshy gape bulge at the root; the upper mandible overhangs the lower by about 1 cm and the seam reads as a crease; handles move both mandibles together (H1_Length, H2_Curve) or the lower alone (H3_Open) without tearing.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: a saturated orange horn with lengthwise streaks, a darker probe tip, the closing seam and the nostril groove painted as two dark lines along each side; a separate pink fleshy gape at the root.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: even neutral light, a narrow highlight along the culmen, no clipping; the groove and seam lines stay visible in the side and close views.
review_notes.gate4_godot: needs revision: orientation only, from the shared forward_cone frame (not this art). On the strider (after_strider_beak_long.jpg) it loads, seats on the snout tip and keeps its orange horn, but stands up like a horn. With the frame fix previewed (conefix_strider_beak_long.jpg) it reaches forward and curves down, reading as an ibis-like probing bill at the world camera's distance.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
